obj_alphys_npc_77.text:
* He wasn't s-supposed
  to ask that one...

obj_alphys_npc_82.text:
* (Yellow feet are tapping
  just behind the door.)

obj_alphys_npc_91.text:
* I... I just need
  a moment.

obj_alphystrigger1_175.text:
* I didn't expect you
  to show up so
  soon!

obj_alphystrigger1_176.text:
* I haven't showered, I'm
  barely dressed, it's
  all messy, and...

obj_alphystrigger1_226.text:
* I'm Dr. Alphys.
* I'm ASGORE's royal
  scientist!

obj_alphystrigger1_227.text:
* B-b-but, ahhhh,
  I'm not one of
  the "bad guys"!

obj_alphystrigger1_228.text:
* Actually, since you
  stepped out of the
  RUINS, I've, um...

obj_alphystrigger1_229.text:
* ... been "observing"
  your journey through
  my console.

obj_alphystrigger1_231.text:
* I was originally
  going to stop
  you, but...

obj_alphystrigger1_236.text:
* Watching someone on
  a screen really makes
  you root for them.

obj_alphystrigger1_237.text:
* Watching you, I felt
  like... like I was
  seeing an old friend.

obj_alphystrigger1_238.text:
* S-so, ahhh, now I
  want to help you!

obj_alphystrigger1_239.text:
* Using my knowledge,
  I can easily guide
  you through Hotland!

obj_alphystrigger1_240.text:
* I know a way right
  to ASGORE's castle,
  no problem!

obj_alphystrigger1_242.text:
* Well, actually, umm,
  there's just a
  tiny issue.

obj_alphystrigger1_243.text:
* A long time ago, I
  made a robot named
  Mettaton.

obj_alphystrigger1_244.text:
* Originally, I built
  him to be an
  entertainment robot.

obj_alphystrigger1_245.text:
* Uh, you know, like
  a robotic TV star
  or something.

obj_alphystrigger1_246.text:
* Anyway, recently I
  decided to make him
  more useful.

obj_alphystrigger1_247.text:
* You know, just some
  small practical
  adjustments.

obj_alphystrigger1_250.text:
* Of c-course, when I
  saw you coming, I
  immediately decided...

obj_alphystrigger1_251.text:
* I have to remove
  those features!

obj_alphystrigger1_252.text:
* Unfortunately, I may
  have made a teensy
  mistake while doing so.

obj_alphystrigger1_254.text:
* Now he's an unstoppable
  killing machine with a
  thirst for human blood?

obj_alphystrigger1_257.text:
* But, ummm, hopefully
  we won't run into
  him!

obj_alphystrigger1_468.text:
* OH BOY!
* I CAN ALREADY TELL IT'S
  GONNA BE A GREAT SHOW!

obj_alphystrigger1_469.text:
* EVERYONE GIVE A BIG
  HAND FOR OUR WONDERFUL
  CONTESTANT!
